how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online only, through the Commission's website upsssc.gov.in. Applications sent through any other mode will not be accepted. The broad process is:
On the UPSSSC homepage, under the "Live Advertisement Segment," locate and download/view the relevant advertisement.
Login via PET-2025 registration number: Candidates authenticate/log in using their PET-2025 registration number, verified via an OTP sent to their registered mobile number/email.

Review auto-filled details: Personal details recorded at PET-2025 (name, parents'/spouse's name, UP residency status, category, EWS status, horizontal reservation details, date of birth, gender, marital status, contact details) are displayed automatically.
Select post(s): Candidates must select the post(s) they wish to apply for; a post not selected will not be considered.

Confirm qualification details: Candidates confirm Yes/No for holding the required qualification for the selected post(s), and enter board/institution/university name, year of passing, certificate/roll number, and marks obtained.
Verify photo and signature: The photo and signature uploaded at PET-2025 are displayed automatically and cannot be changed at this stage.
Preferential qualification and address: Candidates indicate Yes/No for any preferential qualification, and their permanent/correspondence address from PET-2025 is displayed automatically.

Declaration and submission: Candidates must read and accept the declaration, enter the verification code, and submit. A completed application with an 11-digit registration number is generated; a printed copy should be retained safely.

Pay the fee: Pay the applicable fee (see Fee section above) via the payment options on the portal. The application cannot be finally submitted, downloaded, or printed until the fee payment is confirmed/adjusted by the bank.
Download and verify printout: After successful fee payment and adjustment, download and print the application form and check all entries carefully.
important_instructions: Candidates must possess the required essential qualification(s) and other eligibility conditions, and fall within the prescribed age limit, by the application closing date (6 November 2026). Candidates seeking reservation/age relaxation benefits must obtain the relevant caste/reservation certificate, in the prescribed format, issued by a competent authority on or before the date specified in the notification, and must produce it to the Commission when required. EWS category applicants must hold an EWS certificate issued between 1 April 2026 and 6 November 2026 (the application closing date), based on income for financial year 2025–26, valid for financial year 2026–27, in the prescribed format. Candidates must indicate their post preference at the time of document scrutiny; the Commission will attempt to allot posts as per preference, subject to availability, seniority, educational qualification, and age, but the Commission's decision is final. Only one application is to be made for the advertised posts. After final submission, applications can be modified only via the "Modify Application" option on the Applicant's Dashboard, using an OTP sent to the registered mobile/email, and only for specified fields (correspondence address, EWS and horizontal reservation category details, mandatory/preferential qualification details, and marital status) - other details, including category, date of birth, and gender, cannot be changed. Candidates must adjust their fee payment and download their application printout by the closing date or within 7 days thereafter (by 13 November 2026); after this, no fee adjustment or printout will be possible, and the application will not be considered valid. No request for correction/modification will be accepted after the correction deadline of 13 November 2026 under any circumstances. If any discrepancy or false information is found at any stage, the candidate's application/candidature will be rejected, and further debarment or disciplinary action may follow.

content_sections.text: A total of 412 posts are on offer, as per Table-1 of the notification. EWS candidates must hold an EWS certificate, issued between 1 April 2026 and the application closing date (6 November 2026), based on income for financial year 2025–26, valid for financial year 2026–27, in the prescribed format. Reservation for Divyangjan is governed by Uttar Pradesh's Divyangjan Empowerment Section-3 government orders, under which 4% horizontal reservation is ensured across Group Ka, Kha, Ga, and Gha posts; Divyang candidates must mark their specific disability category/sub-category in the application. Reservation for dependants of freedom fighters and ex-servicemen is as per the U.P. Public Services (Reservation for Physically Handicapped, Dependants of Freedom Fighters and Ex-Servicemen) Act, 1993, as amended. Reservation for women follows Uttar Pradesh Personnel Department orders, subject to the outcome of pending litigation referenced in the notification. Reservation for Outstanding Sportspersons follows the U.P. Government Departments (Direct Recruitment of Outstanding Sportspersons to Group-C Posts) Rules, 2022.

faq.question: Q1. What is UPSSSC Yuva Kalyan Adhikari & Vyayam Prashikshak Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a Main Examination notification (Advertisement No. 23-Pariksha/2026) from the Uttar Pradesh Adheenasth Seva Chayan Ayog for 412 posts of Kshetriya Yuva Kalyan evam Pradeshik Vikas Dal Adhikari and Vyayam Prashikshak, open only to candidates who already hold a PET-2025 score card.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in UPSSSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 412 posts: 368 for Kshetriya Yuva Kalyan evam Pradeshik Vikas Dal Adhikari (142 Special Selection + 226 Regular Selection) and 44 for Vyayam Prashikshak (22 + 22).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for UPSSSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application and fee payment last date is 6 November 2026, with fee adjustment and correction permitted up to 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for these UPSSSC posts?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's degree is essential for the Adhikari post, while the Vyayam Prashikshak post additionally requires a D.P.Ed/B.P.Ed qualification. See the Qualification section above for complete details, including preferential qualifications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for UPSSSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 21 and 40 years of age as on 1 July of the calendar year of advertisement, with age relaxation available for SC/ST and other notified categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the UPSSSC application fee?
faq.answer: At this application stage, the fee is ₹25 (online processing fee only) for Unreserved, OBC, SC, and ST candidates. A separate Main Examination fee applies only to shortlisted candidates, payable before downloading the Main Exam admit card.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for UPSSSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible PET-2025 candidates must log in at upsssc.gov.in using their PET-2025 registration number and OTP, then follow the steps described in the How to Apply section above.

faq.question: Q8. What is the UPSSSC selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is based on the written Main Examination (100 questions, 100 marks, 2 hours); candidates must also separately clear a qualifying, discipline-specific Physical Efficiency Test and meet minimum physical standards, as detailed in the Selection Process section above.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for these UPSSSC posts?
faq.answer: Kshetriya Yuva Kalyan evam Pradeshik Vikas Dal Adhikari carries a pay scale of Level-5 (₹29,200–₹92,300), while Vyayam Prashikshak carries Level-6 (₹35,400–₹1,12,400).
